title: assure record
description: Reads the suites' output, the state of the tree, and the spec from the git objects of the commit checked out, and writes the proof run predicate outside the repository for the provider's attestation action. Exits non-zero and writes nothing on an unknown or malformed test ID, a commit that is not the full commit checked out, a tree with uncommitted changes (also changes that git status hides), or a job whose workflow is not the trusted signer.

title: assure gate change
description: Gates the change against the base head in the repository that holds the working folder, reading both commits from git objects; the Lathe CLI is node_modules/.bin/lathe of the repository unless --lathe names another, and the gate job names the Lathe it builds. Reads the trusted signer, the change ref (GITHUB_REF), the API and the token from the job environment, prints the decision with every reason and appends it to the step summary. Exits 0 when the change passes, 1 when it is refused, and 2, with no decision, when called wrongly or when it cannot decide, such as when Lathe finds an error in the spec at either commit.

title: assure gate release
description: Prints the decision, writes the decision predicate for attestation when passed, and exits non-zero when refused. Planned.

title: assure ledger
description: Prints the proof ledger for a commit from verified attestations, and exits non-zero when any automated proof did not pass there. Planned.

title: stego deps
description: stego deps resolves the service's modules and writes go.mod and go.sum.

title: stego build download
description: stego build download writes a module cache for one revision.

title: stego build
description: stego build builds and records the executable. It takes the SDK on the command line today, not from the archetype.

title: stego build verify
description: stego build verify checks an executable against a trusted record.

title: stego build verify-source
description: stego build verify-source checks a source snapshot against a trusted record.

title: stego image build
description: stego image build builds the image.

title: stego image sign
description: Not written yet: stego image sign will sign the image and its SBOMs with keyless cosign.

title: stego image publish
description: stego image publish pushes the image and reads it back.

title: stego image verify
description: stego image verify checks a local image; stego image retrieve checks one from a registry.

title: stego init
description: stego init -archetype <name> scaffolds a declaration in the current folder.

title: stego validate
description: stego validate checks the declaration and prints every fault, or that there is none. It has no structured output yet.

title: stego version
description: stego version prints the version; with --json it prints the version and the build identity.

title: stego fleet
description: Not written yet: stego fleet -digest <digest> <checkout>... will name every service that pins the digest.

title: stego lifecycle supersede
description: Not written yet.

title: stego lifecycle withdraw
description: Not written yet.

title: qualify-compiler-release.py
description: A release script, not a stego command. It qualifies one commit and writes qualification.json.

title: qualify-compiler-release.py --verify-release
description: A release script, not a stego command. It verifies the published release as a consumer installs it.

title: install-compiler.py
description: An installation script, not a stego command. It installs one verified release on Linux amd64.

title: stego fleet measures
description: Not written yet: stego fleet measures <checkout>... will sweep the checkouts and print each outcome measure with the services behind it, as text or with --json as JSON.

title: stego fleet vex
description: Not written yet: stego fleet vex <checkout>... will sweep the checkouts and print one OpenVEX statement per service and advisory.

title: stego env check
description: stego env check reports every platform requirement an environment file does not meet, and exits non-zero when one is unmet. Planned.

title: stego delivery check
description: stego delivery check runs every STEGO check on a CI-built image, as the last step of each provider's pipeline. Planned.

title: stego fill create
description: stego fill create scaffolds a fill and its test for one slot and collection.

title: stego test
description: stego test runs the fills' tests. It records no evidence yet.

title: stego fill sign
description: Not written yet: stego fill sign will sign a fill's evidence with the person's key.

title: stego registry fills
description: stego registry fills lists the project's fills for a slot.

title: stego fill status
description: Not written yet: stego fill status will list the qualification of each bound fill.

title: stego apply
description: stego apply plans and applies, and prints the plan. It has no flag to allow a hand edit, no flag to override a pin that does not stand, cannot read a saved plan, and writes no architecture view yet.

title: stego recover
description: stego recover takes no arguments and completes an interrupted apply.

title: stego drift
description: stego drift prints every drifted file and input, and fails when there is any.

title: stego plan
description: stego plan makes a plan and prints the action for each generated file. Today it saves nothing, so apply plans again.

title: stego assets
description: stego assets captures a frontend build as a checked asset bundle.

title: stego fix
description: Not written yet: stego fix rewrites the declaration to the next declaration version the registry accepts and prints each construct it cannot rewrite, with its path; with --dry-run it prints the rewrite and writes nothing.

title: stego registry inspect
description: stego registry inspect <component> prints one component's version, namespace, ports, slots and settings as text.

title: stego registry search
description: stego registry search [-provides <port>] [-requires <port>] [-slot <slot>] prints the matching components as a table.

title: stego registry promote
description: Not written yet: stego registry promote will copy a component from the local registry into a checkout of the common registry, at stage alpha, for review.

title: stego registry sunsets
description: Not written yet: stego registry sunsets <checkout>... will list every recorded service that uses a component past its sunset without a dated acceptance, and exit non-zero when there is any.

title: stego registry quality
description: Not written yet: stego registry quality will print each ga component's standing against the quality bar and the share that hold it, and exit non-zero when the share is below 100%.
